issues: 门户卡是一张悬浮在网格上方的额外卡片，不在 dashboard 的任何槽位里（违反 Q9），点开的来源不可信
窗内新场景打着调试标题「Scene B」，dashboard 缩略图外套 2px 灰边框，像截图贴在灰底上
近景两张卡散开后有一半出画，最终定格帧里是两块被裁掉的半张卡
放大前没有任何预备动作，旧场景在窗变大时亮度不变，窗与背景没有主次
工作台按默认 150f 推断（时长恰好），但缺少导出常量
changes: 门户卡改为 FakeDashboard A 网格里的真实槽位（第 2 行第 3 张，seed 6，几何按网格精确计算），12–25f 先悬浮抬起 8px / +2% / 阴影变大变虚作预备
窗内换成反差的深色世界：暗色 Backdrop + 静态颗粒 + 深色 dashboard 悬浮窗（发丝亮边 + 深投影），去掉调试标题
两张近景浮卡改深色版并从终点反推散开前位置，×1.3 散开后完整落在画内、压住大窗两角形成前后景
保留 40f bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) 放大、0.08/0.3 两层视差与 65–73f 缓停；旧场景随窗变大压暗 32%，窗挂随高度变化的两层软阴影；补导出 PORTAL_WIPE_V2_DURATION = 150
issuesEn: The portal card was an extra card floating above the grid, not sitting in any dashboard slot (violates Q9), so the origin of the 'open' wasn't believable
The inner scene carried a debug title "Scene B", and its dashboard thumbnail had a 2px gray frame, like a screenshot pasted on gray
After spreading, the two foreground cards ended half off-screen, so the final held frame showed two cropped half-cards
There was no anticipation before the expansion, and the old scene kept full brightness as the window grew, so there was no hierarchy
The workbench defaulted to 150f (correct by luck) but no duration constant was exported
changesEn: The portal card is now a real slot in FakeDashboard A's grid (row 2, column 3, seed 6, geometry computed from the grid); from 12–25f it lifts 8px, scales +2% and its shadow grows softer as anticipation
The inner scene is now a contrasting dark world: dark Backdrop with static grain and a dark dashboard window (hairline light edge, deep shadow); the debug title is gone

The two foreground cards use the dark tone and are back-solved from their end positions, so after the ×1.3 spread they sit fully in frame, overlapping two corners of the big window for foreground/background depth

Kept the 40f bezier(0.7,0,0.3,1) expansion, the 0.08/0.3 two-layer parallax and the 65–73f settle; the old scene darkens 32% as the window grows, and the window carries a height-dependent two-layer soft shadow; exported PORTAL_WIPE_V2_DURATION = 150
